# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c5 P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)</sub>

## Appearance

He has a dark, small face, black eyes, and a dark, gloomy demeanor.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)_

## Personality

Anthony is a challenging, stubborn, and quiet pupil who initially shows defiance and sullenness toward authority. Though he resists polite lectures, he respects strength and physical discipline, holding a pragmatic view of standard rules.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c12 P54](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0054)_

## Traits

- Dark and gloomy  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- Sullen and defiant  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)</sub>
- Respectful of physical strength  <sub>[v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)</sub>

## History

Anthony attended Brierley School under the instruction of Nell Harcourt, sitting at a corner desk by himself. On the first day of class, he displayed clear hostility toward Nell and poured water from his slate bottle onto Aurelia Clay's neck. Kept inside during recess, he listened to Nell's lecture on gentlemanly behavior completely unaffected. Later, when Nell lost her temper, she punished him with a pointer, causing him to cry and step back. Rather than holding a grudge, the whipping earned his respect, as he considered the punishment to be as effective as a man's. Afterwards, he broke his habit of ignoring Nell by offering to carry her books through the snow on her way to school.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P32](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0032), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_
